subject: Seasonal Buoy Program - Point Separation mile 913 to Kittigazuit Bay mile 1081
text:
Seasonal Buoy Program - Point Separation mile 913 to Kittigazuit Bay mile 1081
The seasonal decommissioning of Canadian Coast Guard navigational buoys is underway in : 
Point Separation mile 913 to Kittigazuit Bay mile 1081 including the Luker channel.
